add.event: 埃克尔斯出任联邦储备委员会主席
add.evidence: Marriner Stoddard Eccles became the governor of the Federal Reserve Board on November 15, 1934.

add.event: "政府银行法案"提交众议院银行与货币委员会
add.evidence: On February 5, 1935, the "Administration banking bill", as it was initially titled, was given to the House Committee on Banking and Currency.
